name: Memory Recall
description: Episodic memory retrieval — recall value-ranked context from all memory layers plus the work ledger for Cortex; leads with high-value learnings; frames failures as forward lessons, never feasibility verdicts.
author: architect-prime
_scripts_note: Recall is daemon-prefetched and toolless on the hot path (C-5) — the daemon gathers the raw layers and temporal-memory synthesizes the packet. session-summary is declared by memory-consolidate, which is the mode that actually runs it.
when_to_use: When Cortex dispatches temporal-memory for recall — retrieve relevant context from working memory, core memory, episodic work history, and recent sessions.
